title: Chen Ling's Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a violent fluctuation emanated from the depths of the Tianji Record—that was the will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, approaching silently.

text.content: The surging heat from the depths of his bloodline made Chen Ji's consciousness instantly crystal clear. He could sense something within the fourth page of the Tianji Record struggling and transforming violently—that was Chen Ling, the existence jointly nurtured by his bloodline and the rules of the Tianji Record, undergoing an unprecedented awakening.

Chen Ji whispered her name softly. The Tianji Record opened on its own, and the curled shadow within the fourth page trembled violently. Countless tiny cracks spread from the core of the shadow, yet were instantly sealed by some force—that was Chen Ling tearing apart her old shackles with all her might. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the first page trembled slightly, as if also observing this transformation.

"Brother..." A muffled murmur emerged from the fourth page, carrying an emotion Chen Ji had never heard before—no longer mechanical obedience, no longer hollow responses, but a genuine, living call. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and an indescribable soreness surged in his chest.

Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, yet carried unprecedented warmth. He extended his right hand, fingertips gently touching the page of the fourth page. The Heavenly Fate Value remaining in his body, as if sensing the call, flowed on its own toward the transforming shadow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed: "This is your choice, but also her fate's tribulation. Young man, are you certain you want to do this?"

choice.prompt: At the critical moment of Chen Ling's awakening, how does Chen Ji choose to respond?

choices.description: Channel all his Heavenly Fate Value to the fourth page without reservation, helping Chen Ling complete her awakening, even if it means falling into weakness himself.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling gains complete independent consciousness
choices.risk_hint: His own combat power will greatly decrease

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. The Heavenly Fate Value in his body surged toward the fourth page like a breached flood. Those were his hard-earned trump cards, now毫不hesitated地化作陈灵蜕变的养分.

choices.description: Transfer an appropriate amount of Heavenly Fate Value to aid the awakening, while preserving enough strength to handle possible unexpected situations.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ling's awakening may be incomplete
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may not gain complete abilities

text.content: Chen Ji rationally controlled the output of Heavenly Fate Value, ensuring Chen Ling had sufficient energy for transformation while not allowing himself to fall into dangerous weakness. This was his consistent style—calculating everything, never leaving any flaws.

The light of the fourth page suddenly blazed intensely. Chen Ling's shadow gradually凝聚出清晰的轮廓 in the radiance. It was a young girl figure bearing seven tenths resemblance to Chen Ji. Her brows carried the unique sharpness of the Chen family's bloodline, yet gained an ethereal, otherworldly temperament from the Tianji Record's immersion. Her双眸slowly睁开，那里面不再是空洞的程序，而是一片星辰般璀璨的光芒.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I... I feel like I had a very long, very long dream. The whole dream was filled with your voice."

text.content: Chen Ling's voice carried trembling, that unique uncertainty of newborn consciousness. She lowered her head to gaze at her hands, feeling the power surging within her, then raised her eyes to look at Chen Ji, her eyes full of dependence and trust: "After I woke up, I discovered I could... could help you with many things now. No longer just passive responses, but active thinking, active fighting."

dialogue.content: (Inner voice: I remember this, the cost of this awakening. Once I figure out the price behind this, I will pay it back.)

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at his sister before him, complex emotions churning within his heart. He recalled the price of the Tianji Record Fragment, the Heavenly Fate consumed each time he glimpsed the future, and his helpless state when Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect. He reached out, gently brushing his fingers across Chen Ling's forehead—a tenderness so unlike his usual demeanor.

dialogue.content: Brother, I'm no longer a tool, right? I can decide what to do myself now, right?

text.content: Chen Ling's question carried the unique longing of nascent consciousness. She was no longer the program that could only respond passively, but a true subject with the power of choice. Her gaze locked tightly onto Chen Ji, awaiting the answer from the man who had granted her bloodline and guided her awakening.

choice.prompt: How would Chen Ji respond to Chen Ling's eager pursuit of independence?

choices.text: Clearly state: You will always be my partner.
choices.description: Directly tell Chen Ling that she is not a tool, but a true partner. Emphasize the relationship of fighting side by side.
choices.visible_reward: Build a genuine relationship of trust.
choices.risk_hint: Might cause her to become overly dependent.

dialogue.content: You were never a tool, Chen Ling. From the moment of your birth, you have been my partner. That will not change.

choices.text: Rational guidance: You have the freedom to choose.
choices.description: Tell Chen Ling she has the right to choose, but also must bear the consequences that come with her choices.
choices.visible_reward: Help her establish an independent personality.

dialogue.content: You have the freedom to choose, Chen Ling. But remember, every choice comes with a cost. I won't make decisions for you, but I will be right behind you.

text.content: At this moment, an unusual fluctuation pulsed from deep within the Tianji Record. It was an external窥探, as if some powerful existence was attempting to investigate what was happening here. Chen Ling's brow furrowed slightly—for the first time, she actively sensed this threat—it was an ability belonging to the Tianji Record, yet now voluntarily activated by her.

dialogue.content: Brother, something is approaching... I can sense it! It's the will of the Heavenly Eye!

text.content: A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. The Heavenly Eye—that terrifying existence beyond the Heavenly Dao—actually began paying attention at this moment. What did this mean? Had Chen Ling's awakening triggered some forbidden mechanism, or had the Heavenly Eye always been monitoring every move of the Tianji Record? Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul trembled violently, seeming extremely wary of this窥探.

dialogue.content: (Inner thought: So it's finally here? It seems the Tianji Record's disturbances have alerted entities of that level. Noted.)

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his mind was already racing at full speed. The Heavenly Eye's will descending—this came earlier than he had anticipated. He had originally believed he would have more time to lay his plans, but now it seemed every step required even greater caution. He looked at Chen Ling, his gaze carrying a question: "Can you help me mask it?"

dialogue.content: Of course! Brother, did you forget? I'm your partner now, not a tool!

text.content: Chen Ling's answer carried unprecedented confidence. Her hands formed seals, and layers of mysterious patterns surged within her body—those were abilities granted by the Tianji Record, yet now actively triggered by her. A Demonic Path mist-like aura spread from her, shrouding the entire fourth page's space tightly. That probing will seemed blocked by this layer of mist, hesitating momentarily.

Chen Ji gazed at this Chen Ling, transformed beyond recognition, a faint smile curving his lips. At this moment, he truly understood what "partner" meant. No longer one-sided output and consumption, but an existence he could rely on, could entrust his back to. He thought of Su Qingyao, of Ye Qing, of those who had fought alongside him in this chess game.

"Chen Ling." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried undeniable sincerity, "From now on, I am no longer your human-machine integration architecture, but your partner." These words, he had long wished to say. Only before this, he had been observing, confirming—that Chen Ling truly possessed independent will, that she could bear the weight of the word "partner."

dialogue.content: En! From now on, I am no longer a tool, I am your companion!

text.content: Chen Ling's eyes slightly reddened, that was the first time her newborn consciousness experienced emotional resonance. She could feel the weight of Chen Ji's words, and also sense the genuine emotion that this always cold and calculating man was showing at this moment. She nodded vigorously, her voice choked with emotion: 'I will work hard, brother. I will become stronger, strong enough to truly stand by your side, instead of being protected behind you.'

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floated quietly on the first page, witnessing this scene. A glimmer of relief flickered in his eyes, mixed with a hint of worry. Chen Ling's awakening meant the Tianji Record's functions would be further unlocked; it also meant that the Heavenly Eye, always hidden behind the scenes, would pay more attention to this situation. The chess game was becoming increasingly complex.

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Ling's determination, how would Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Grateful acceptance: Let me see your strength then
choices.description: Accepting Chen Ling's determination, providing her an opportunity to prove herself by independently completing a task.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling obtains a growth opportunity

dialogue.content: Alright, I will await your performance. But remember, the meaning of being companions is fighting side by side, not sending yourself to death for me.

choices.text: Protection priority: We face it together
choices.description: Emphasizing that the two are companions, should advance and retreat together, rather than letting Chen Ling take risks alone.
choices.risk_hint: May attract more attention from the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content: The meaning of being companions is facing everything together. From now on, no matter what we encounter, we are two people. Understand?

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to continue speaking, the fluctuation transmitted from the depths of the Tianji Record suddenly intensified. That probing gaze, temporarily blocked by Chen Ling's mist, had become even clearer—the Heavenly Eye's will seemed to be growing stronger as it pierced through the mist. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emitted a low, solemn warning: 'It is approaching! Lad, whatever you two intend to do, you'd better hurry!'

dialogue.content: Brother, I can do it! Let me help you block it!

text.content: Chen Ling's voice carried unprecedented power. Her hands formed seals once more, and the Tianji Record's power within her body was pushed to its extreme. Mysterious runes emerged from her body, weaving a complex formation net within the fourth page's space. That was the first display of independent deduction ability—Chen Ling was analyzing the Heavenly Eye's will's weaknesses in her own way.

Chen Ji watched the completely transformed Chen Ling before him, a warm current rising in his heart. This existence that once only responded passively had now grown into a true companion capable of proactively fighting and thinking. He reached out and tightly grasped Chen Ling's hand. The two's bloodlines resonated within the Tianji Record, and an unprecedented power was quietly gathering.

Remember," Chen Ji's voice was low and resolute, "no matter what happens, I will never let you face it alone. From now on, we fight side by side." Chen Ling nodded heavily, determination blazing in her eyes. At this moment, the siblings' wills achieved an unprecedented unity. And that probing gaze from the Heavenly Eye, repelled by the two's combined resistance, was temporarily forced back.

The Tianji Record's radiance gradually subsided, and Chen Ling's first independent awakening battle ended in a draw. But everyone knew this was merely the beginning. The Heavenly Eye's will would not take this lying down, and Chen Ji and Chen Ling, this newly formed pair of companions, were about to face greater trials. However, at this moment, after this breathtaking confrontation, the siblings smiled at each other, everything understood without words.

Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, an intense fluctuation pulsed from the depths of the Tianji Record—the Heavenly Eye's will was stealthily approaching. This time, it seemed to carry some more definite purpose, no longer mere probing, but revealing a chilling obsession. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; he sensed that this existence transcending the Heavenly Dao had seemingly locked onto a certain target—and that target was very likely his sister who had just gained independent consciousness.
